text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
What wonderful weather! The sun is shining 
bright, and my mood is completely clear!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On days without training and the like, I 
sometimes take walks with Gran Alegria 
like this.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The walking route is fairly fixed, 
covering just the right distance to get 
back to the academy at a good time, but...

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
"The weather's so lovely today, let's take 
a little trip! I know a wonderful spot."

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
It's a very special view, after all. It's 
truly beautiful, so I know you'll love it 
too, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Gran Alegria leads the way with an excited 
look on her face. I felt happy that she 
was willing to share her favorite spot 
with me—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I didn't think too deeply about just how 
far her "trip" would take us.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
The rustling leaves sound like applause! 
It sort of makes me want to run.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Pardon? What is the matter?
choice_data_list:
I feel like we've been walking quite a 
while now, though...

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha. Not even close! If this were a 
race, we'd still be in the early stages.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
"Still... shall we pick up the pace a 
little? The view at dusk is the most 
beautiful, so we can't miss it!"

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Actually, once it gets dark, the sky is 
about the only thing worth seeing around 
here. So, let's hurry!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Gran Alegria marches steadily forward. 
Meanwhile, my footing was getting 
unsteady, and I found myself stopping more 
and more. But—

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
We'll be out of the woods soon. Hehe. I'm 
so happy I get to see that view with you~!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
It's a place I found when I was little, 
running around with Mama~ So it's really 
special to me!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Yes. In that very spot, I reaffirmed my 
resolve to Mom. "I'm gonna become the Mile 
Queen!", I told her.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
And Mom said, "I'm looking forward to it!" 
Hehe, I'll be sure to tell Trainer about 
it again today!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Encouraged by Gran Alegria's muttering, I 
lifted my heavy feet.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
We're here!! What do you think? The sky is 
so wide open, it feels amazing, doesn't 
it?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I somehow managed to arrive before 
nightfall. My stamina was pushed to the 
absolute limit, and I couldn't help 
collapsing right onto the ground.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
"Huh, Trainer? Are you okay!? Whoa, your 
knees are shaking!"

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
"It doesn't look like you can stand 
anymore... Leave it to me, I'll carry you 
on my back on the way home! If you'd only 
said something on the way here, too—"
choice_data_list: Don't worry about it. I mean...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"I told her that while I was indeed tired 
and pushed myself too hard, I wanted to 
reach Gran Alegria's special place on my 
own two feet."
choice_data_list:
Because I want us to reach our destination 
side by side.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Wah... W-W-Wahhh!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Trainer! Right now, I feel so great!! Can 
you guess how many miles this feeling is 
worth!?
choice_data_list:
Infinite miles... that would make me so 
happy!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Spot on! That's my Trainer for you! You 
haven't been by my side all this time for 
nothing!!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Fufu. Well then, once again—

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna become the Mile Queen!! Together 
with you, Trainer!!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
"Close! The correct answer is Infinite 
Infinity Mile!"

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha! Make sure you guess it right next 
time you visit!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
"I'm sure that when that time comes, I'll 
be feeling just as happy as I am right 
now!"

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
That's a perfect score of an answer!! I 
couldn't have said it better myself.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Fufu. Well then, once again—

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna become the Mile Queen!! Together 
with you, Trainer!!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Ah, I just this second passed 100 miles!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Ahahaha. Still, it just goes to show how 
happy I am!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
So, I'll save the right quiz answer for 
next time. Because I'm sure coming here 
again next time will make me just as happy 
as I am now!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
"Lucky seven! Yes, that's exactly how I 
feel!"

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Fufu. Well then, once again—

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna become the Mile Queen!! Together 
with you, Trainer!!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
"Lucky seven? No, no, this number wasn't 
decided by luck at all!"

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
I'm fine! Just make sure to guess it right 
next time you come here.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
"I'll make sure to share all this 
happiness with you!"
